reason: The patch removes the explicit `tracing.TraceIDFromContext` lookup, so `pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:58` now gets traceID only through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)`, which iterates the global `ctxLogProviders` (`pkg/infra/log/log.go:206`); the traceID provider is registered only as a side effect of `tracing.ProvideService` (`pkg/infra/tracing/tracing.go:91`). No comment in `logger_middleware.go` mentions this, and there is no logger middleware test file in that directory.
